title: Every object of the pro-etale site has a hypercovering whose terms are single weakly contractible objects
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every object of the pro-etale site of a scheme admits a hypercovering whose every term is a single weakly contractible object, and that a quasi-compact and quasi-separated object admits such a hypercovering with each term a single affine weakly contractible object (statement lines 3215-3227). The proof (proof lines 3229-3266) applies the hypercovering construction to finite coverings by weakly contractible objects, replaces hypercoverings by their degreewise disjoint unions, and repeats the argument inside the subcategory of quasi-compact and quasi-separated objects using affine weakly contractible coverings. H2: two parallel constructions with four inputs, written out in full.
